name: Data.Pair.intAlgPart_eq_mul_L
summary: The squared norm of the lift is C·(explicit counts)·L (`LValueData.inner_trivialLift_self_eq_L`); the counts at Q cancel against the normalisation of intAlgPart, leaving a constant A independent of ϑ.

steps.claim: For every ϑ: ⟨Ξ_ϑ, Ξ_ϑ⟩ = C·∏(q − 1)·hookNumber·#WeylIndex·L((νϑ)⁻¹, places, z)·(∏_{w∈Q} q_w)^{|n|−1} with C ≠ 0 depending only on the chosen places (`LValueData.inner_trivialLift_self_eq_L` for lValueData(H, ϑ), |n| = 2z, z > 1).
steps.lean: have h ϑ := (lValueData H ϑ).inner_trivialLift_self_eq_L H.1.symm H.2

steps.claim: Take A = intAlgPart-normalisation times C·∏(q − 1)·hookNumber·#WeylIndex (the same for all ϑ: the chosen places and the weights do not depend on ϑ); then intAlgPart(H, ϑ) = A·L(…) for every ϑ, the power of the norm of Q cancelling; A ≠ 0 remains.
steps.lean:
refine ⟨_, ?_,
    fun ϑ ↦ by simp_all [trivialLift, norm_smul, div_eq_iff, mul_pow, range_chosen, levelPlaces,
    ← ϑ.Q.prod_coe_sort, ← mul_assoc, -Fintype.card_pi]; dsimp +instances [levelPlaces, AuxPair.κ]⟩

steps.claim: A ≠ 0, from C ≠ 0 at the trivial twist.
